ownerDecision.quote: Java children: no JVM-option injection (no JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS or JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS; they print to stderr, affect every java process and have split the Gradle daemon pool before). G2 covers environment-based resolution only. Instead, list every test-launched Java child (ProcessBuilder/launch helpers reachable from test source sets) and say whether it receives an explicit data/home path; those that don't are a known gap, reported in your reply, not fixed here (they belong to the product step that follows).
